title: O‘zim, oilam va qarindoshlar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida oila a’zolarini ingliz tilida nomlaysiz, my/your/his/her so‘zlarini to‘g‘ri ishlatasiz, have/has bilan kimingiz borligini aytasiz va oilangiz haqida kasb va yoshlarni qo‘shib kamida olti gap gapirasiz.

scenes.title: To‘rtinchi darsga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! To‘rtinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda yuzgacha sanashni, yoshingizni va telefon raqamingizni aytishni o‘rgandik. Bugun eng yaqin mavzu: oilangiz. Oila a’zolarining nomlarini, “my, your, his, her” so‘zlarini, “have” va “has” fe’llarini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Hello! Today we will talk about family. By the end of the lesson, you will describe your family in English.
scenes.say_uz: Salom! Bugun oila haqida gaplashamiz. Dars oxirida oilangizni ingliz tilida tasvirlab bera olasiz.

scenes.title: Ota-ona
scenes.say_native: Boshlaymiz. “Mother” — ona, “father” — ota. Uyda, samimiy gapda inglizlar “mum” va “dad” deyishadi, xuddi biz “oyi” va “dada” deganimizdek. Amerikada “mum” o‘rniga “mom” yoziladi va aytiladi. Ota va onani birgalikda “parents” deymiz, ya’ni ota-ona. E’tibor bering: “parents” doim ko‘plikda keladi, chunki u ikki kishini bildiradi. Bitta ota yoki onani “a parent” deyish mumkin.
scenes.say: Mother. Father. Mum and dad. My parents.
scenes.say_uz: Ona. Ota. Oyi va dada. Ota-onam.

scenes.title: Aka-uka, opa-singil
scenes.say_native: Endi aka-uka va opa-singillar. Ingliz tilida bor-yo‘g‘i ikki so‘z: “brother” va “sister”. “Brother” ham aka, ham uka; “sister” ham opa, ham singil. Yoshini aniq aytish kerak bo‘lsa, oldiga “older” — katta yoki “younger” — kichik so‘zini qo‘shamiz: “my older brother” — akam, “my younger brother” — ukam. Britaniyada “elder brother” ham deyiladi, ma’nosi bir xil.
scenes.say: Brother. Sister. My older brother. My younger sister.
scenes.say_uz: Aka-uka. Opa-singil. Akam. Singlim.

scenes.title: Aka va uka uchun alohida so‘z yo‘q
board: ✓ my older brother / my younger brother
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida yosh farqi juda muhim, shuning uchun ba’zi o‘quvchilar inglizcha gapga “aka” so‘zini qo‘shib yuborishadi yoki “small brother” deyishadi. “Small” — jismoniy kichik degani, yosh uchun ishlatilmaydi. To‘g‘ri: “younger brother” — ukam, “older brother” — akam. Ko‘pincha esa inglizlar yoshini umuman aytmaydi, shunchaki “my brother” deydi.
scenes.say: Not: my small brother. Say: my younger brother, or just my brother.
scenes.say_uz: My small brother emas. My younger brother yoki shunchaki my brother deng.

scenes.title: Bobo va buvi
scenes.say_native: Endi bobo va buvi. Oldiga “grand” qo‘shilsa, bir avlod uzoqroq degani. “Grandmother” — buvi, “grandfather” — bobo, ikkalasi birga “grandparents”. Samimiy gapda “grandma” va “grandpa” yoki “granny” deyiladi. Teskari tomoni: “grandson” — o‘g‘il nevara, “granddaughter” — qiz nevara, hammasi birga “grandchildren”.
scenes.say: Grandmother, grandfather, grandparents. Grandson, granddaughter, grandchildren.
scenes.say_uz: Buvi, bobo, bobo-buvi. Nevara (o‘g‘il), nevara (qiz), nevaralar.

scenes.title: Er-xotin va farzandlar
scenes.say_native: Turmush o‘rtoqlar: “husband” — er, “wife” — xotin yoki rafiqa. Farzandlar: “son” — o‘g‘il, “daughter” — qiz. Bitta bola “child”, ko‘pligi esa “children”. Bu noto‘g‘ri ko‘plik, oxiriga “s” qo‘shilmaydi, “childs” degan so‘z yo‘q. Og‘zaki nutqda “kids” ham juda ko‘p ishlatiladi. Yana bir narsa: “wife” ning ko‘pligi “wives”, chunki “f” harfi “v” ga aylanadi.
scenes.say: Husband and wife. Son and daughter. One child, two children.
scenes.say_uz: Er va xotin. O‘g‘il va qiz. Bitta bola, ikkita bola.

scenes.title: Amma, xola, amaki, tog‘a
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida qarindoshlar uchun so‘z ko‘p: amma, xola, amaki, tog‘a. Ingliz tilida esa ancha sodda. Ota yoki onaning opa-singlisi — “aunt”. Ota yoki onaning aka-ukasi — “uncle”. Ota yoki onaning tomoni muhim bo‘lsa, “my mother’s sister” — onamning singlisi, deb aniqlashtiriladi. Amakivachcha, xolavachcha, ammavachcha — hammasi bitta so‘z: “cousin”, u jinsni ham bildirmaydi.
scenes.say: Aunt. Uncle. Cousin. Nephew. Niece.
scenes.say_uz: Amma, xola. Amaki, tog‘a. Amakivachcha. Jiyan (o‘g‘il). Jiyan (qiz).

scenes.title: Talaffuz: th, gh va aunt
scenes.say_native: Talaffuzga e’tibor bering. “Mother”, “father”, “brother” so‘zlaridagi “th” jarangli tovush: tilning uchini tishlar orasiga yengil qo‘yib, “z” ga o‘xshatib aytasiz. “D” yoki “z” demang. “Daughter” so‘zida “gh” umuman o‘qilmaydi: “do:-tə”. Britaniya talaffuzida so‘z oxiridagi “r” ham aytilmaydi. “Aunt” so‘zi Britaniyada “a:nt”, Amerikada esa “ent” deb aytiladi. Ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: Mother. Father. Brother. Daughter. Aunt.
scenes.say_uz: Ona. Ota. Aka-uka. Qiz. Xola, amma.

scenes.title: Kim bu?
scenes.say_native: Topishmoqlar. Har bir ta’rifni o‘qing va bitta so‘z bilan javob bering. Birinchi: onamning onasi kim? Ikkinchi: otamning akasi kim? Uchinchi: xolamning o‘g‘li kim? To‘rtinchi: opamning qizi kim? Javobni baland ovozda, ingliz tilida ayting. Har bir so‘zda “’s” ni “-ning” deb tushuning.
scenes.say: My mother's mother? My father's brother? My aunt's son? My sister's daughter?
scenes.say_uz: Onamning onasi? Otamning akasi? Xolamning o‘g‘li? Opamning qizi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: onamning onasi — “grandmother”, ya’ni buvim. Otamning akasi — “uncle”. Xolamning o‘g‘li — “cousin”. Opamning qizi — “niece”, qiz jiyan. Agar uchinchi savolga “brother” desangiz, bu xato: “brother” faqat sizning ota-onangizning farzandi. Xolaning bolasi esa doim “cousin”.
scenes.say: Grandmother. Uncle. Cousin. Niece.
scenes.say_uz: Buvi. Amaki. Xolavachcha. Jiyan (qiz).

scenes.title: my va your
scenes.say_native: Endi egalik so‘zlari. O‘zbek tilida egalikni qo‘shimcha bilan bildiramiz: opam, opangiz. Ingliz tilida esa alohida so‘z otdan oldin keladi. “I” — men, “my” — mening: “my sister” — opam. “You” — siz, “your” — sizning: “your sister” — opangiz. Qo‘shimcha yo‘q, faqat so‘z oldida turadi. “Your” ham “sening”, ham “sizning” ma’nosini beradi, ingliz tilida bu farq yo‘q.
scenes.say: My mother. My father. Your brother. Your sister.
scenes.say_uz: Onam. Otam. Akangiz. Opangiz.

scenes.title: his va her
board: Tom and his sister · Anna and her brother

examples.t: This is Tom and his sister.
This is Anna and her brother.

scenes.say_native: Eng muhim joy. O‘zbek tilida “uning” bitta so‘z. Ingliz tilida esa ikkita: egasi erkak bo‘lsa “his”, ayol bo‘lsa “her”. Diqqat qiling: qaysi so‘zni tanlash narsaga emas, egasiga bog‘liq. “Tom and his sister” — Tom va uning singlisi; egasi Tom, u erkak, shuning uchun “his”, garchi singil ayol bo‘lsa ham. “Anna and her brother” — egasi Anna, demak “her”.
scenes.say: Tom and his sister. Anna and her brother. Aziz and his mother. Malika and her father.
scenes.say_uz: Tom va uning singlisi. Anna va uning akasi. Aziz va uning onasi. Malika va uning otasi.

scenes.title: his yoki her: misollar

examples.t: My father and his brother are doctors.
My aunt lives with her children.

scenes.say_native: Yana misollar. “Aziz and his wife” — Aziz va uning xotini. “Lola and her husband” — Lola va uning eri. “My father and his brother” — otam va uning akasi. “My aunt and her children” — xolam va uning bolalari. Har safar o‘zingizdan so‘rang: egasi kim, erkakmi yoki ayolmi? Javobga qarab “his” yoki “her” ni tanlaysiz. Bu bir necha kunlik mashqdan keyin avtomatik bo‘lib qoladi.
scenes.say: Aziz and his wife. Lola and her husband. My father and his brother. My aunt and her children.
scenes.say_uz: Aziz va uning xotini. Lola va uning eri. Otam va uning akasi. Xolam va uning bolalari.

scenes.title: his va her ni aralashtirmang
board: ✗ Aziz and her sister → ✓ his sister
scenes.say_native: Bu o‘zbek o‘quvchilarining eng ko‘p qiladigan xatosi. Ona tilimizda “u” va “uning” jinsni bildirmagani uchun gapirayotganda “his” va “her” almashib ketadi: “Malika and his brother”. Bu inglizga g‘alati eshitiladi, go‘yo Malika erkakdek. Rus tilini bilsangiz, bu yerda u yordam beradi: ruschadagi “yego” — “his”, “yeyo” — “her”. Har safar egasining jinsini tekshiring.
scenes.say: Malika and her brother. Aziz and his sister.
scenes.say_uz: Malika va uning akasi. Aziz va uning singlisi.

scenes.title: our, their, its
scenes.say_native: Yana uchta egalik so‘zi. “We” — biz, “our” — bizning: “our house” — uyimiz. “They” — ular, “their” — ularning: “their children” — ularning bolalari. “It” — narsa yoki hayvon, “its” — uning: “The cat and its kittens” — mushuk va uning bolalari. Diqqat: “its” da apostrof yo‘q. Apostrofli “it’s” — bu boshqa narsa, “it is” ning qisqa shakli.
scenes.say: Our parents. Their children. The dog and its toy.
scenes.say_uz: Ota-onamiz. Ularning bolalari. It va uning o‘yinchog‘i.

scenes.title: Egalik so‘zi bilan “the” kelmaydi
scenes.say_native: Yana ikki xato. Birinchisi: egalik so‘zi bilan birga “the” yoki “a” ishlatish: “the my mother”. Egalik so‘zi artiklning o‘rnini egallaydi, ikkalasi birga kelmaydi. Ikkinchisi: “me mother” yoki “mine brother”. “Me” va “mine” — boshqa so‘zlar, ular otdan oldin kelmaydi. Otdan oldin faqat “my” turadi: “my mother”, “my brother”.
scenes.say: My mother. Not the my mother. My brother. Not me brother.
scenes.say_uz: My mother. The my mother emas. My brother. Me brother emas.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri so‘zni qo‘ying
board: 4) The children and ___ parents are here.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta gapda bo‘sh joy bor. “His, her, our, their” so‘zlaridan birini tanlang. Birinchi gapda egasi Aziz, ikkinchisida Anna, uchinchisida “we” — biz, to‘rtinchisida “the children” — bolalar. Egasiga qarang, narsaga emas. Javobni to‘liq gap bilan baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Aziz loves… wife. Anna and… sister. We love… grandparents. The children and… parents.
scenes.say_uz: Aziz … xotinini yaxshi ko‘radi. Anna va … singlisi. Biz … bobo-buvimizni yaxshi ko‘ramiz. Bolalar va … ota-onalari.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “Aziz loves his wife” — egasi Aziz, erkak, demak “his”. “Anna and her sister” — Anna ayol, “her”. “We love our grandparents” — “we” dan keyin “our”. “The children and their parents” — bolalar ko‘plik, demak “their”. To‘rttasini ham to‘g‘ri topgan bo‘lsangiz, egalik so‘zlarini yaxshi tushundingiz.
scenes.say: Aziz loves his wife. Anna and her sister are students. We love our grandparents. The children and their parents are here.
scenes.say_uz: Aziz xotinini yaxshi ko‘radi. Anna va singlisi talaba. Biz bobo-buvimizni yaxshi ko‘ramiz. Bolalar va ota-onalari shu yerda.

scenes.title: Ism + ’s: Aziz’s sister
scenes.say_native: Ismga egalik qo‘shish uchun ingliz tilida apostrof va “s” qo‘shamiz: “Aziz’s sister” — Azizning singlisi. Yaxshi xabar: so‘z tartibi o‘zbek tili bilan bir xil. Avval ega, keyin narsa: Azizning — singlisi, “Aziz’s — sister”. “’s” qo‘shimchasini o‘zbekchadagi “-ning” deb tasavvur qiling. Agar so‘z ko‘plikda bo‘lib, “s” bilan tugasa, faqat apostrof qo‘yiladi: “my parents’ house”.
scenes.say: Aziz's sister. My father's name. My parents' house.
scenes.say_uz: Azizning singlisi. Otamning ismi. Ota-onamning uyi.

scenes.title: the sister of Aziz emas
scenes.say_native: Rus tilini biladigan o‘quvchilar ko‘pincha “sestra Aziza” iborasini tarjima qilib “the sister of Aziz” deyishadi. Grammatik jihatdan butunlay xato bo‘lmasa ham, odamlar haqida gapirganda bunday deyilmaydi. Yana bir xato — apostrofni tashlab yuborish: “Aziz sister”. Og‘zaki nutqda “s” tovushi albatta eshitilishi kerak: “Aziz’s” so‘zi “a-zi-ziz” bo‘lib eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Aziz's sister. Malika's brother. Tom's father.
scenes.say_uz: Azizning singlisi. Malikaning akasi. Tomning otasi.

scenes.title: Inglizchaga o‘giring
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zbekchadan ingliz tiliga o‘giring. Birinchi: Malikaning eri. Ikkinchi: otamning opasi. Uchinchi: Tomning bolalari. To‘rtinchi: buvimning ismi. Har birida apostrof va “s” ni unutmang, so‘z tartibi esa o‘zbek tilidagidek qoladi. Javobni avval o‘ylab, keyin baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Translate into English.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tiliga tarjima qiling.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “Malika’s husband”. “My father’s sister”, va bu bir so‘z bilan “my aunt”. “Tom’s children”. “My grandmother’s name”. E’tibor bering, ikkinchi va to‘rtinchi misolda ikkita egalik ketma-ket keldi: “my” va “’s”. O‘zbek tilida ham xuddi shunday: otamning opasi, buvimning ismi.
scenes.say: Malika's husband. My father's sister. Tom's children. My grandmother's name.
scenes.say_uz: Malikaning eri. Otamning opasi. Tomning bolalari. Buvimning ismi.

scenes.title: have va has
board: I have a sister. She has two sons.
scenes.say_native: Endi “bor” degan ma’no. O‘zbek tilida “mening akam bor” deymiz, ya’ni egalik va “bor” so‘zi. Ingliz tilida esa ega gapning boshida turadi va “have” fe’li ishlatiladi: “I have a brother” — so‘zma-so‘z “men akaga egaman”. “I, you, we, they” bilan “have”, “he, she, it” bilan esa “has”. Bitta odam haqida gapirganda “has” deysiz: “She has two sons”, “My uncle has three children.”
scenes.say: I have a brother. You have a sister. She has two sons. They have a big family.
scenes.say_uz: Mening akam bor. Sizning opangiz bor. Uning ikki o‘g‘li bor. Ularning katta oilasi bor.

scenes.title: have va has: ko‘proq misollar
board: Tom has a cousin in Tashkent.

examples.t: Tom has a cousin in Tashkent.

scenes.say_native: Ko‘proq misollar tinglang. “We have two daughters” — ikki qizimiz bor. “Tom has a cousin in Tashkent” — Tomning Toshkentda amakivachchasi bor. “My parents have five grandchildren” — ota-onamning beshta nevarasi bor. Uchinchi gapga e’tibor bering: “my parents” ko‘plik, ya’ni “they”, shuning uchun “have”. Ega bitta odammi yoki ko‘pmi, shunga qarab tanlaysiz.
scenes.say: We have two daughters. Tom has a cousin in Tashkent. My parents have five grandchildren.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki qizimiz bor. Tomning Toshkentda amakivachchasi bor. Ota-onamning beshta nevarasi bor.

scenes.title: Britaniyacha: have got
board: I've got a sister. = I have a sister.
She's got two kids. = She has two kids.
've got = have got · 's got = has got
scenes.say_native: Britaniyada og‘zaki nutqda “have” o‘rniga ko‘pincha “have got” ishlatiladi. Ma’nosi bir xil. “I’ve got a sister” — opam bor. “She’s got two kids” — uning ikki bolasi bor. Bu yerda “’s” — “has” ning qisqa shakli, “is” emas. Amerikada esa oddiy “have” ko‘proq ishlatiladi. Siz ikkalasini ham tushunishingiz kerak, gapirganda esa qaysi biri qulay bo‘lsa, shuni ishlating.
scenes.say: I've got two brothers. She's got a son. We've got a big family.
scenes.say_uz: Mening ikki akam bor. Uning o‘g‘li bor. Bizning katta oilamiz bor.

scenes.title: She have — xato
board: ✗ She have a brother. → ✓ She has
✗ My have a sister. → ✓ I have
✗ I have two brother. → ✓ two brothers
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Birinchisi: “she” yoki “he” bilan “have” ishlatish. “She have” emas, “She has”. Ikkinchisi: o‘zbekchadan so‘zma-so‘z tarjima — “mening bor” deb “My have a sister”. Ingliz tilida gap “I” bilan boshlanadi: “I have a sister.” Uchinchisi: ko‘plik qo‘shimchasini unutish. Ikki, uch, besh desangiz, so‘z oxiriga “s” qo‘shiladi: “two brothers”.
scenes.say: She has a brother. I have a sister. I have two brothers.
scenes.say_uz: Uning akasi bor. Mening opam bor. Mening ikki akam bor.

scenes.title: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
board: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
Yes, I do. I have one sister.
No, I don't. I'm an only child.
scenes.say_native: Oila haqida eng ko‘p beriladigan savol: “Do you have any brothers or sisters?” — aka-uka yoki opa-singillaringiz bormi? Bu savolning tuzilishini keyingi darslarda batafsil o‘rganamiz, hozir uni tayyor ibora sifatida eslab qoling. Qisqa javob: “Yes, I do” — ha, bor, yoki “No, I don’t” — yo‘q. Keyin bir gap qo‘shing: “I have one sister.” Yolg‘iz farzand bo‘lsangiz: “I’m an only child.”
scenes.say: Do you have any brothers or sisters? Yes, I do. I have one sister. Do you have any children? No, I don't.
scenes.say_uz: Aka-uka, opa-singillaringiz bormi? Ha, bor. Bitta opam bor. Farzandlaringiz bormi? Yo‘q.

scenes.title: have yoki has?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta gapni “have” yoki “has” bilan to‘ldiring. Har birida egaga qarang: bitta odammi, “he” yoki “she” o‘rnidami, yoki ko‘p odammi. Javobni to‘liq gap bilan baland ovozda ayting. Shoshilmang, har bir gapda avval egani toping, keyin fe’lni tanlang.
scenes.say: My sister… two sons. We… a small family. My grandparents… a big house. Aziz… a cousin in London.
scenes.say_uz: Opamning … ikki o‘g‘li. Bizning … kichik oilamiz. Bobo-buvimning … katta uyi. Azizning … Londonda amakivachchasi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “My sister has two sons” — opam bitta odam, “she”, demak “has”. “We have a small family” — “we” bilan “have”. “My grandparents have a big house” — bobo-buvim ikki kishi, ya’ni “they”, demak “have”. “Aziz has a cousin in London” — Aziz bitta odam, “he”, demak “has”. Uchinchi gap eng qiyini edi, chunki “my” so‘zi bor, lekin muhimi egasining soni.
scenes.say: My sister has two sons. We have a small family. My grandparents have a big house. Aziz has a cousin in London.
scenes.say_uz: Opamning ikki o‘g‘li bor. Bizning kichik oilamiz bor. Bobo-buvimning katta uyi bor. Azizning Londonda amakivachchasi bor.

scenes.title: Oila hajmi
board: There are five people in my family.
I have a big / small family.
How many people are there in your family?

examples.t: There are four people in my family.

scenes.say_native: Endi oila hajmi haqida. Savol: “How many people are there in your family?” — oilangizda necha kishi bor? Javob: “There are five people in my family” — oilamizda besh kishi. Yoki qisqaroq: “There are five of us” — biz beshtamiz. Umumiy baho ham berishingiz mumkin: “I have a big family” — oilam katta, “I have a small family” — oilam kichik.
scenes.say: How many people are there in your family? There are five people in my family. There are five of us.
scenes.say_uz: Oilangizda necha kishi bor? Oilamizda besh kishi bor. Biz beshtamiz.

scenes.title: We are five — xato
board: ✓ There are five people in my family.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek yoki rus tilidan so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilib “We are five” yoki “My family is five people” deyish juda keng tarqalgan xato. Ingliz tilida oila soni “there are” bilan aytiladi: “There are five people in my family.” Qisqasi: “There are five of us.” Sonni aytayotganda yana bir narsani unutmang: “people” allaqachon ko‘plik, unga “s” qo‘shilmaydi.
scenes.say: There are five people in my family. There are five of us.
scenes.say_uz: Oilamizda besh kishi bor. Biz beshtamiz.

scenes.title: Kasblar: a doctor, an engineer
board: a + undosh tovush · an + unli tovush
scenes.say_native: Oila a’zolarining kasbini aytamiz. “My father is a doctor” — otam shifokor. Ingliz tilida kasbdan oldin “a” yoki “an” so‘zi albatta turadi. Kasb nomi undosh tovush bilan boshlansa — “a”: “a teacher, a driver, a doctor”. Unli tovush bilan boshlansa — “an”: “an engineer, an accountant, an artist”. O‘zbek tilida “otam shifokor” deyish kifoya, ingliz tilida esa bu kichik so‘z majburiy.
scenes.say: My father is a doctor. My mother is an engineer. My brother is a driver.
scenes.say_uz: Otam shifokor. Onam muhandis. Akam haydovchi.

scenes.title: Ko‘plik, nafaqa va uy bekasi
scenes.say_native: Bir nechta odam haqida gapirsangiz, “a” tushib qoladi va kasb ko‘plikda bo‘ladi: “My parents are teachers” — ota-onam o‘qituvchi. Nafaqadagi odam haqida “retired” deymiz: “My grandfather is retired.” Bu sifat, shuning uchun “a” kerak emas. Uy bekasi — “a housewife”, hozir ko‘pincha neytral “a homemaker” ham ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: My parents are teachers. My grandfather is retired. My sister is a student.
scenes.say_uz: Ota-onam o‘qituvchi. Bobom nafaqada. Singlim talaba.

scenes.title: Kasbdan oldin a/an
board: ✗ He is a engineer. → ✓ an engineer
✗ They are a doctors. → ✓ They are doctors.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi eng ko‘p uchraydi: “My mother is teacher.” O‘zbek va rus tillarida artikl yo‘q, shuning uchun uni tashlab ketamiz. To‘g‘risi: “a teacher”. Ikkinchisi: unli tovushdan oldin “a” deyish: “a engineer” emas, “an engineer”. Uchinchisi: ko‘plikda “a” qoldirish: “They are a doctors” emas, “They are doctors.” “A” so‘zi faqat bitta narsa uchun.
scenes.say: My mother is a teacher. He is an engineer. They are doctors.
scenes.say_uz: Onam o‘qituvchi. U muhandis. Ular shifokor.

scenes.title: a, an yoki hech narsa?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta gap. Har biriga “a”, “an” yoki hech narsa kerakligini toping. Kasb nomining birinchi tovushiga va gapdagi odamlar soniga qarang. Javobni to‘liq gap qilib ayting. Esda tuting: harf emas, tovush muhim, shuning uchun so‘zni ichingizda aytib ko‘ring.
scenes.say: My aunt is… nurse. My uncle is… engineer. My cousins are… students. My brother is… artist.
scenes.say_uz: Xolam … hamshira. Tog‘am … muhandis. Amakivachchalarim … talaba. Akam … rassom.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “My aunt is a nurse” — “nurse” undosh tovush bilan boshlanadi, demak “a”. “My uncle is an engineer” — “engineer” unli tovush bilan boshlanadi, demak “an”. “My cousins are students” — ko‘plik, artikl yo‘q. “My brother is an artist” — yana unli tovush, “an”. Agar hammasini to‘g‘ri topgan bo‘lsangiz, kasblar haqidagi navbatdagi darsga tayyorsiz.
scenes.say: My aunt is a nurse. My uncle is an engineer. My cousins are students. My brother is an artist.
scenes.say_uz: Xolam hamshira. Tog‘am muhandis. Amakivachchalarim talaba. Akam rassom.

scenes.title: Yosh va oilaviy holat
board: She is married. / He is single.
My brother is married with two children.

examples.t: My cousin is nineteen. He is single.
examples.uz: Amakivachcham o‘n to‘qqiz yoshda. U uylanmagan.

scenes.say_native: Oila a’zosini tasvirlaganda yoshini ham aytish mumkin. Oldingi darsdan esingizda bo‘lsa, yosh “years old” bilan yoki shunchaki son bilan aytiladi: “My sister is twenty-five.” Oilaviy holat uchun ikki so‘z: “married” — turmush qurgan, ham erkak, ham ayol uchun bitta so‘z, va “single” — turmush qurmagan. O‘zbek tilidagi “uylangan” va “turmushga chiqqan” farqi ingliz tilida yo‘q.
scenes.say: My sister is twenty-five. She is married. My cousin is nineteen. He is single.
scenes.say_uz: Opam yigirma besh yoshda. U turmush qurgan. Amakivachcham o‘n to‘qqizda. U turmush qurmagan.

scenes.title: Dialog: suratga qarab
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Ikki do‘st, Jasur va Kate, telefondagi oilaviy suratni ko‘rishyapti. Kate suratdagi odamlar haqida so‘raydi, Jasur esa javob beradi. Tinglagandan keyin uchta savolga javob berasiz: Nilufar kim, u nima ish qiladi, va suratdagi bola kim? Diqqat bilan tinglang.
scenes.say: Who's this, Jasur? This is my sister, Nilufar. She's a teacher. Is she married? Yes, she is. This is her husband, Bobur. And who's this little boy? That's their son, Amir. He's four. He's my nephew. Oh, he's lovely!
scenes.say_uz: Bu kim, Jasur? Bu mening opam Nilufar. U o‘qituvchi. U turmush qurganmi? Ha. Bu uning eri Bobur. Bu kichkina bola kim? Bu ularning o‘g‘li Amir. U to‘rt yoshda. U mening jiyanim. Oh, juda shirin!

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: 3) Who is Amir? How old is he?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: Nilufar Jasurning kimi? Ikkinchi: Nilufarning kasbi nima? Uchinchi: Amir kim va u necha yoshda? Javoblarni ingliz tilida, to‘liq gap bilan aytishga harakat qiling. Masalan, “She is…” yoki “He is…” deb boshlang. Esingizda bo‘lmasa, dialogni yana bir marta tinglang.
scenes.say: Who is Nilufar? What is her job? Who is Amir? How old is he?
scenes.say_uz: Nilufar kim? Uning kasbi nima? Amir kim? U necha yoshda?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) Amir is Jasur's nephew. He is four.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Nilufar — Jasurning opasi: “She is Jasur’s sister.” U o‘qituvchi: “She is a teacher.” Amir — Nilufar va Boburning o‘g‘li, ya’ni Jasurning jiyani: “He is Jasur’s nephew. He’s four.” Dialogdagi “their son” iborasiga ham e’tibor bering: o‘g‘il ikki kishiga tegishli, shuning uchun “their”.
scenes.say: Nilufar is Jasur's sister. She is a teacher. Amir is Jasur's nephew. He is four.
scenes.say_uz: Nilufar Jasurning opasi. U o‘qituvchi. Amir Jasurning jiyani. U to‘rt yoshda.

scenes.title: Dialog: Emmaning oilasi
board: How many people? · Jobs? · Brothers or sisters?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog uzunroq. Til kursida o‘qituvchi Emmadan oilasi haqida so‘rayapti. Tinglab bo‘lgach, uchta savolga javob berasiz: Emmaning oilasida necha kishi bor, otasi va onasi kim bo‘lib ishlaydi, va Emmaning aka-ukasi yoki opa-singlisi bormi? Kerak bo‘lsa, qayta tinglang.
scenes.say: Emma, tell us about your family. Well, there are four people in my family: my mum, my dad, my brother and me. My dad's name is Peter. He's a doctor. My mum is an accountant. Do you have any sisters? No, I don't. I've got one brother, Sam. He's twenty-two and he's a student. And your grandparents? They're retired. They live in Manchester.
scenes.say_uz: Emma, oilangiz haqida aytib bering. Xo‘sh, oilamizda to‘rt kishi bor: onam, otam, akam va men. Otamning ismi Piter. U shifokor. Onam buxgalter. Opa-singillaringiz bormi? Yo‘q. Bitta akam bor, Sem. U yigirma ikki yoshda va talaba. Bobo-buvingiz-chi? Ular nafaqada. Ular Manchesterda yashaydi.

scenes.title: Emma haqida
board: 1) How many people are there in Emma's family?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Emmaning oilasida necha kishi bor? Uning ota-onasi kim bo‘lib ishlaydi? Sem kim va u nima qiladi? Bobo-buvisi qayerda yashaydi? Javoblarni daftaringizga yozing yoki baland ovozda ayting. Iloji boricha to‘liq gap bilan javob bering, masalan: “There are… people in Emma’s family.”
scenes.say: How many people are there in Emma's family? What are her parents' jobs? Who is Sam? Where do her grandparents live?
scenes.say_uz: Emmaning oilasida necha kishi bor? Ota-onasining kasbi nima? Sem kim? Bobo-buvisi qayerda yashaydi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Emmaning oilasida to‘rt kishi bor. Otasi Piter shifokor, onasi esa buxgalter: “an accountant” — unli tovush, shuning uchun “an”. Sem — uning akasi, yigirma ikki yoshda, talaba. Bobo-buvisi nafaqada va Manchesterda yashaydi. Emmaning “I’ve got one brother” deganiga e’tibor bering: bu britaniyacha “have got”.
scenes.say: There are four people in Emma's family. Her dad is a doctor and her mum is an accountant. Sam is her brother. Her grandparents live in Manchester.
scenes.say_uz: Emmaning oilasida to‘rt kishi bor. Otasi shifokor, onasi buxgalter. Sem uning akasi. Bobo-buvisi Manchesterda yashaydi.

scenes.title: Namuna: mening oilam
board: There are five people in my family.
scenes.say_native: Endi to‘liq namunani tinglang. Unda bugungi hamma narsa bor: oila soni, egalik so‘zlari, “have” va “has”, kasblar va yosh. Gaplar qisqa va oddiy, lekin birgalikda yaxshi hikoya bo‘ladi. Xuddi shunday hikoyani hozir o‘zingiz ham tuzasiz, shuning uchun tuzilishiga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Dilnoza. There are five people in my family. My father's name is Rustam. He is an engineer. My mother is a nurse. I have a brother and a sister. My brother is twenty. He is a student. My sister is married. She has a son. His name is Timur.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, men Dilnozaman. Oilamizda besh kishi bor. Otamning ismi Rustam. U muhandis. Onam hamshira. Mening akam va opam bor. Akam yigirma yoshda. U talaba. Opam turmush qurgan. Uning o‘g‘li bor. Uning ismi Temur.

scenes.title: Endi siz: oilangiz haqida
board: There are ___ people in my family.
scenes.say_native: Bugungi asosiy mashq. Ekrandagi rejaga qarab, oilangiz haqida kamida olti gap ayting. Oilada necha kishi borligini, ota-onangizning kasbini, aka-uka va opa-singillaringizni ayting. Kamida bir marta “his”, bir marta “her” va bir marta “has” ishlating. Baland ovozda, shoshilmasdan gapiring.
scenes.say: Now tell me about your family. Start!
scenes.say_uz: Endi oilangiz haqida aytib bering. Boshlang!

scenes.title: O‘zingizni tekshiring
board: ✓ There are… people in my family.
scenes.say_native: Gapingizni tekshiring. Oila sonini “There are” bilan aytdingizmi, “We are five” emasmi? Kasbdan oldin “a” yoki “an” qo‘ydingizmi? “He” va “she” bilan “has” ishlatdingizmi? Erkak haqida “his”, ayol haqida “her” dedingizmi? Ko‘plikda “s” bormi: “two brothers”? Hammasi to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, siz bugungi maqsadga erishdingiz.
scenes.say: There are five people in my family. My mother is a nurse. My sister has a son. His name is Timur.
scenes.say_uz: Oilamizda besh kishi bor. Onam hamshira. Opamning o‘g‘li bor. Uning ismi Temur.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: mother, father, brother, sister, aunt, uncle, cousin
my · your · his · her · our · their · Aziz's
I have / she has · There are five of us
My father is a doctor. (a / an)
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Oila a’zolari nomlarini o‘rgandik va ingliz tilida aka-uka, amma-xola uchun alohida so‘zlar yo‘qligini bildik. Egalik so‘zlari otdan oldin keladi, “his” va “her” egasining jinsiga bog‘liq. Ismga “’s” qo‘shib egalikni bildiramiz. “Bor” ma’nosi uchun “have” va “has” ishlatiladi. Oila soni “There are” bilan aytiladi, kasbdan oldin esa “a” yoki “an” keladi.
scenes.say: Well done! Now you can talk about your family in English.
scenes.say_uz: Barakalla! Endi oilangiz haqida ingliz tilida gapira olasiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: his / her · has · a / an + job
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Oilangizdan to‘rt kishini tanlang va ular haqida olti gap yozing. Har bir odamning kimligini, kasbini yoki yoshini ayting. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida bitta “his” va bitta “her” to‘g‘ri ishlatilgan, “he” va “she” bilan “has” turibdi, har bir kasbdan oldin “a” yoki “an” bor. Keyin gaplaringizni baland ovozda o‘qing. Keyingi darsda “to be” fe’li va eng oddiy gaplarni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: See you next time. Goodbye!
scenes.say_uz: Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz. Xayr!

homework_uz: Oilangizdan 4 kishini 6 ta gapda tasvirlang: kimligi, kasbi yoki yoshi. Mezon: kamida bitta his va bitta her to‘g‘ri ishlatilgan, he/she bilan has, har bir kasbdan oldin a yoki an, ko‘plikda -s (two brothers), oila soni There are… bilan.

quiz.why_uz: Onaning opa-singlisi — aunt (xola). Uncle — erkak qarindosh.
Egasi Malika — ayol, demak her. His faqat egasi erkak bo‘lsa.
He/she bilan has, ikki va undan ko‘p bo‘lsa ko‘plik -s: two sons.
Kasbdan oldin a/an kerak; teacher undosh bilan boshlanadi — a teacher.
Ismga ’s qo‘shiladi, tartib o‘zbekchadek: Aziz’s sister.

options: There are five people in my family.
quiz.why_uz: Oila soni There are… bilan aytiladi. We are five — so‘zma-so‘z tarjima.
Engineer unli tovush bilan boshlanadi, shuning uchun an.
Ukam — my younger brother (yoki shunchaki my brother). Small yosh uchun ishlatilmaydi.

quiz.q: Do you have any sisters? — No, …
quiz.why_uz: Do you have…? savoliga qisqa javob: Yes, I do / No, I don’t.
